directive.goal: По просьбе пользователя убрать случайные верхние обрубки зелени над шалфейными шторами и построить мягкое неоднородное утреннее небо за французским окном, сохранив озеро, лес, раму и комнату.

style_contract.shape_language: rounded organic edges, no extraneous disconnected green shards
style_contract.edge_policy: architectural window frames crisp, sky/air soft, foliage irregular
style_contract.contour_role: only meaningful branching at the curtain top
style_contract.value_policy: soft luminous warm horizon and gentle cooler morning sky
style_contract.color_policy: warm cream peach to muted blue green morning air above lake
style_contract.material_treatment: continuous sky field not flat vector polygon
style_contract.texture_policy: low-frequency atmospheric change, no fake sharp clouds
style_contract.primitive_footprint_tolerance: remove geometric leaf shards disconnected from stems
style_contract.layer_or_mask_bias: reversible Photoshop layer masks and separate sky layer
style_contract.finish_criteria: both top corners clean; sky visibly graded without painting over white mullions or curtains

white frames and distant forest preserved
